title: "state_population"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# install.packages(c("readr","dplyr","tidyr","stringr"))
rm(list=ls()); gc()

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

# 1) Source files (official Census PEP CSVs)
url_2000_2009 <- "https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/datasets/2000-2009/national/totals/nst_est2009_alldata.csv"
url_2010_2019 <- "https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/datasets/2010-2019/national/totals/nst-est2019-alldata.csv"
url_2020_2025 <- "https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/datasets/2020-2025/state/totals/NST-EST2025-ALLDATA.csv"

# 2) Read the three files
df_2000_2009 <- read_csv(url_2000_2009, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(vintage = 2009)
df_2010_2019 <- read_csv(url_2010_2019, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(vintage = 2019)
df_2020_2025 <- read_csv(url_2020_2025, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(vintage = 2025)

# 3) Keep state-level rows (SUMLEV 040) and reshape into (state, year, population)
to_state_year <- function(df) {

  df_clean <- df %>%
    mutate(
      SUMLEV = as.character(SUMLEV),
      STATE  = as.integer(STATE)
    ) %>%
    filter(SUMLEV %in% c("40","040")) %>%     # robust to numeric vs "040"
    filter(!is.na(STATE), STATE > 0)

  long <- df_clean %>%
    select(STATE, NAME, vintage, starts_with("POPESTIMATE")) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = starts_with("POPESTIMATE"),
      names_to = "year",
      values_to = "population"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = parse_number(year),
      state_fips = str_pad(as.character(STATE), width = 2, side = "left", pad = "0")
    ) %>%
    filter(state_fips != "72") %>%            # drop Puerto Rico (state-equivalent) if you only want 50 + DC
    select(state_fips, state_name = NAME, year, population)

  long
}

pop_2000_2009 <- to_state_year(df_2000_2009) %>% filter(year >= 2004, year <= 2009)
pop_2010_2019 <- to_state_year(df_2010_2019)
pop_2020_2025 <- to_state_year(df_2020_2025)

state_pop <- bind_rows(pop_2000_2009, pop_2010_2019, pop_2020_2025) %>%
  arrange(state_fips, year)

write_csv(state_pop, "state_population.csv")

```
